summary: Dispatches in-race milestone events based on lap number modulo 5 and driver position. Called on lap completion. Event 13 is dispatched when the driver's data at +0x4894 matches the current player vehicle field at offset 18580 and lap % 5 == 1. Event 19 is dispatched when position is 1, lap >= 2, and (lap + 3) % 5 == 0 (i.e. lap % 5 == 2). Returns 0 in all paths.

operations.description: Load lap number from this+0x403C into a local.
Dispatch context: this function is invoked on lap completion by LapCompletion.
First condition: this+0x4894 equals the value at current player vehicle (dword_7C54F0[dword_7C54DC]) + 18580, and lap % 5 == 1.
When the first condition holds, dispatch event 13 via sub_4D8760(13, 0).
Second condition: this+0x4060 (position) equals 1 and lap >= 2 and (lap + 3) % 5 == 0.
When the second condition holds, dispatch event 19 via sub_4D8760(19, 0).
Return 0 regardless of whether either event was dispatched.
